    ## [What should happen the second a client pays you, so you do not look disorganized?](https://www.theautomatestack.com/blog/what-should-happen-the-second-a-client-pays-you/)

    Payment should trigger a chain: a welcome message, the intake form, a client folder, a row in your client sheet and a link to book the first session. Build that chain once and every new client gets the same smooth start within a minute, whether you are working, asleep or offline.

    ## [Should I hire a virtual assistant for admin work, or is there a cheaper way?](https://www.theautomatestack.com/blog/should-i-hire-a-virtual-assistant-or-automate-my-admin-first/)

    Automate the repetitive, rule-based tasks first: data entry, reminders, invoices and follow-ups. Hire a person for judgment, relationships and anything that changes every time. If you hire first, you pay a human to do robot work and you spend weeks explaining a process that is not written down yet.

    ## [What should I do before Black Friday as an online seller?](https://www.theautomatestack.com/blog/what-should-i-do-before-black-friday-as-an-online-seller/)

    ## [How do I know which tasks in my business to automate first?](https://www.theautomatestack.com/blog/how-do-i-know-which-tasks-in-my-business-to-automate-first/)

    Start with the task you repeat most that needs no real thinking. Write down what you actually do for one week, then pick the one that eats the most time. Automate that one, test it, and only then pick the next.
